title: How retries work
bottom_line: A retry helps only when waits grow and the number of attempts is capped.

sections.heading: Why retry
sections.idea: Most failures are brief, so a second try often succeeds.

blocks.text: Retrying at once multiplies load on a server that is already struggling.

sections.heading: Growing waits
sections.idea: Each wait doubles, so a struggling server gets room to recover.

check.q: What is the wait before attempt 4 with doubling from 1 s?
